integrity: Mathematical proof given with quantifiers and boundary equality; 57 finite direct-density checks are reproducibility cross-checks, not universal proof. Literature searches give best-knowledge novelty only.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive four-level Pauli MPS only; contiguous finite nonempty blocks and one contiguous separator of positive integer length; infinite translation-invariant bulk state. Endpoint p_j=0, multipartite block unions, parent-Hamiltonian gaps and general MPS not covered. Ruskai octahedron and tensor injectivity are established ingredients. Independent priority or audit is not claimed.
title: Exact two-block entanglement length for injective Pauli matrix-product states
